main_text.p: certa ? Et tamen non pudet Stephanum talibus adversus Ecclesiam patrocinium præstare, & propter hæreticos afferendos fraternitatem scindere: insuper & Cyprianum Pseudo-Christum, Pseudapostolum, & dolosum operarium dicere ? Quæ omnia in se esse conscius prævenit, ut alter; ea per mendacium objiceret, quæ ipse ex merito audiret. Hactenus illi, quorum Epistolam libenter se, exemplo Manutii, omissurum fuisse Pamelius, nisi Morellius & Turnebus ipse, priores in lucem eam produxissent, fatetur.

page.notes: The faint, mirrored text in the middle and lower part of the page is show-through from the reverse and was not transcribed. The catchword "Ec-" and the signature "C" are read from the foot of the page.
